statusLine.command: input=$(cat); tokens=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // .model.id // ""'); awk -v t="$tokens" -v m="$model" 'BEGIN { val = t / 1000.0; if (t < 10000) c = "34"; else if (t <= 100000) c = "32"; else c = "31"; if (m != "") printf "\033[%sm%.1fk\033[0m %s\n", c, val, m; else printf "\033[%sm%.1fk\033[0m\n", c, val }'
